title: Running away to play and dating the Seymour and Jeanette stockings
summary: She ran away to be with musicians until her mother fetched her. She dates the first job with Seymour and Jeanette to about 1925-26 from stockings she still keeps.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So when you got back from your summer's tour, what became of your career then?
Well I was still in school, in school for a long time, but see I'd go out in summer vacations. One time I ran away and my mother came and got me.
Where did you go? Why did you run away?
Well, because I had that blood in me like a gypsy. I wanted to go out and play, be with musicians.

I really don't know. I was under 16 because you know, because when I played with Duke Ellington's Washingtonians I was between 16 and 17. I just found a date I went to Pittsburgh... I have some stockings, my first stockings that I wore with Seymour and Jeanette; I'll show them to you later. I just washed them last night. Peter brought all these things out in a trunk and so I found the date. It was in about '25 or '26 when I was with Seymour and Jeanette.
You mean you washed them and they didn't fall apart?
No. I'll show them to you; they're wonderful. I have all the first things that I wore with them, except the shoes and the dress. You were asking me about -
